rules.S1: Typed field membership: exact original type=attack parent, without interpreting text.
rules.S2: Exact authored attackType scalar belongs to its original parent.
rules.T1: Original ancestor relationship plus shared-parser tag span; no applied gameplay meaning.
rules.N1: Reject an alleged descendant relationship across sibling field/item boundaries.
rules.N2: Reject a structured hit section on a text-only action wrapper.
rules.A1: Abstain from semantic association inferred only by local word/tag adjacency.
rules.A2: Abstain from interpreted range, targeting, exceptions and applied-effect prose.
rules.A3: Abstain when source lacks a structured actor/recipient/shared-outcome relationship.
